title: Universal localizations glue across monomorphic simplicial pushouts
statement: Use simplicial sets, degreewise products and pullbacks of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and universal localization of [def-coef-universally-localizing-simplicial-map]. A monomorphism means a degreewise injection; pushouts are formed degreewise. Let $A_{01}\to A_0$, $A_{01}\to A_1$ and $B_{01}\to B_0$, $B_{01}\to B_1$ be spans of small simplicial sets, with a strictly commuting map of spans $(f_{01},f_0,f_1)$. Assume that $A_{01}\to A_0$ and $B_{01}\to B_0$ are monomorphisms and that $f_{01},f_0,f_1$ are universally localizing. Then the induced map $A_0\amalg_{A_{01}}A_1\to B_0\amalg_{B_{01}}B_1$ is universally localizing. No injectivity is required of the other legs or vertical maps, and none of these simplicial sets is required to be a quasicategory.
